column1: # Product renders on Logitech's public CDN, keyed by HID product id.
# Read by the app (src-tauri/src/artwork.rs, compiled in) and by
# scripts/fetch-artwork.sh, so the two always agree. Images are downloaded to
# the user's own machine at runtime and never redistributed with OpenGHub.
#   product id   lowercase hex, 4 digits. Any id the device reports works:
#                its USB, receiver (wpid) or Bluetooth id.
# Only add a line after checking the URL returns a real image (HTTP 200 and
# more than a few hundred bytes). A wrong path returns 404.
